dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: Wow! I haven't had any faunal contact in ages!

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: My name's Chloris! I'm the best botanist in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: I spend all my days out in the wild, among the flora. Fauna, on the other hand, are somewhat lacking in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: So you can always feel free to talk to me. I'd appreciate the company!

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: You might know my little sister, Flora?

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: All she cares about is flowers. She runs a flower shop in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: I'm much more open-minded than she is. I care about all plants, especially strange new ones!

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: I guess I am the older one, after all. I do think Flora really could do better if she pushed herself...

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: Can you sell me some plants?

dialogues.speaker: Chloris
dialogues.text: Of course. Unlike Flora's flower shop, we sell all plants here. We do not discriminate.
